response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer, but the profile is almost entirely web/backend (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than C++. Hands-on C++ work is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014–2015 plus a university thesis project, far short of the required 5–10 years of production C++ on Windows. There is no evidence of SQL Server/Oracle experience, no Windows-platform specialization, and no fixed income, derivatives, or capital-markets domain exposure beyond a brief stint at an investment-focused startup (RIDE Capital) where the stack was Node/GraphQL. Strong engineering fundamentals and communication skills do not offset the core mandatory gaps for this role.
strengths: Broad, senior-level engineering experience with strong TDD/CI/CD practices
Excellent communication: conference talks, workshops, and course authoring
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience, over a decade ago
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital-markets domain background
No demonstrated SQL Server/Oracle or Windows-platform development depth
